name: Wrecked sky train (Lakeland Clipper)
about: Intro track IN-3: the crashed sky train on the prepared run's landing (tools/build-intro-art.py): a Skyline Station train broken in two, the front carriage nosed into the ground, the second tipped on its side, a broken piece of the sky rail, Bureau crates spilled from the cargo; battered, smoking (fx plume, thinner at the walk view's lower quality steps). A prebuilt mesh (the airship's format). One look per train, its region theme as the form: base lakeland, v 1 greenbelt, v 2 wildwood, v 3 highland, v 4 harvest
